newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-All Ordinaries climbs to record high.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-All Ordinaries climbs to record high.

text.p: The Australian Stock Exchange's key barometer, the All Ordinaries index, climbed to a record high on Friday, up 22.8 points to 2385.3 by 2.45 p.m. (0345 GMT), following the surge to record highs on Wall Street on Tuesday.
The previous record of 2380.8 was set on October 15, 1996.
The record prior to that was in February 1994 at 2350.4.
By 3.20 p.m. (0420 GMT), the All Ordinaries had gone further ahead to an intraday high of 2,391.0, up 28.5 points on the day.
